scope: User-authorized borderless explanation beside the unchanged overfitting loss graph: shared illustrative observations, common trend versus fitting individual variation, and conditional consequences for new data.

visual_checks.aside_layout: The 185px borderless explanation is visually separate from the loss plot while remaining inside its concept card. Its title, shared-point key, mini figures and conditional outcome fit without wrapping errors or clipping.
visual_checks.mini_comparison: Both small figures show the same five gray observations. The blue line summarizes their overall trend; the solid Amber polyline follows each observation. Direct headings make the comparison readable.
visual_checks.main_legend_distinction: The main legend names loss series as training Blue solid and validation Amber dashed. The aside has its own title, gray-point training-data key and direct subheadings; its Amber model-fit line is solid and its mini plots show observations rather than loss over progress. In these rendered views the legend roles remain distinguishable, with no confirmed incorrect mapping requiring a revision.
visual_checks.technical_wording: The outcome says new-data error may increase. It does not state every interpolation necessarily overfits, nor that new-data performance was measured from these sketches. SVG descriptions preserve their illustrative status.
visual_checks.preserved_figures: The main loss graph, axes, minimum marker, guide gap, best.pt, conditional region and generalization fruit/model diagram remain readable. The central-minimum variant also fits with the aside present.
visual_checks.main_hierarchy: The Blue concept labels, Navy main titles, 24px-separated figure headings and definitions remain coherent; new h4/h5 titles render Navy.
visual_checks.bounds: Representative Scroll/Slide views, eight-view contact and latest nine-source contact show no new text/graph/card/footer overlap.

independent_mini_figure_check.method: Parsed the actual source point coordinates and used the uncentered least-squares normal equations, independently of the verifier centered-covariance formula.
independent_mini_figure_check.metric_scope: These residuals verify drawing arithmetic in SVG coordinate units. They are not the mean squared loss or unit of the main learning-progress graph and are not measured validation/test performance.
independent_mini_figure_check.generalization_claim_limit: Five training observations and their fit do not establish the true data-generating pattern or unseen-data performance. The mini figures illustrate the stated noise-fitting scenario and conditional risk.

evidence_checks.regression_scope: Current eight-reference/font/six-viewport checks, interactive boundary states, Scroll/Slide regression, logistic regression, gradient descent, Markdown checks and 72-case heading/card audit passed. Dedicated overfitting tests include altered and rejected data, keyboard/mode behavior, fonts and graph geometry.

preservation_and_classification.classification: C: topic-specific illustrative observations, explanatory structure and geometry. Existing common gap, color and typography tokens are reused; no new common Markdown omission is established by this change.

limits: This is an internal preview pass for the displayed authorized explanation. User visual review and common Markdown finalization remain separate pending steps.

Blue/Amber have local meanings in the separate figures; interpretation depends on their explicit direct labels and distinct dashed/solid validation/interpolation treatment. This review is not a reader-study claim that color reuse can never confuse.
The mini least-squares line is an illustrative trend, not proof of the true pattern. Interpolation alone is not sufficient evidence of overfitting; new-data behavior remains a conditional statement.
The new aside is subordinate borderless content, not another outer teaching card; the declared 23-card/184-pair scope is retained.
Historical color-only, label-presence, merged-card and spacing reviews are preserved as records of those versions.
No universal independent-author reproduction claim, new-concept reuse approval for every pattern, common Markdown finalization or main merge approval is made.
